root_cause.text: In `uvc_start_streaming_video()`, when `uvc_pm_get()` fails, the function returned the error without calling `uvc_queue_return_buffers()`, leaving buffers queued and violating the videobuf2 core requirement that all buffers must be returned on start_streaming failure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `goto err_buffers` after the `uvc_pm_get()` failure check, which calls `uvc_queue_return_buffers()` before returning. Previously, only the `uvc_video_start_streaming()` failure path released buffers; the `uvc_pm_get()` failure path omitted this call, triggering the WARNING at `vb2_start_streaming()` in videobuf2-core.c.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing buffer return cleanup when uvc_pm_get fails in uvc_start_streaming_video, ensuring proper error handling and resource cleanup.
intent_record.what: Changed error handling in uvc_start_streaming_video to use goto labels for cleanup: on failure of uvc_pm_get, jump to err_buffers; on failure of uvc_video_start_streaming, jump to err_pm; err_pm calls uvc_pm_put then falls through to err_buffers which calls uvc_queue_return_buffers and returns ret.
intent_record.how: Ensures that when uvc_pm_get fails, uvc_queue_return_buffers is called to return queued buffers, preventing resource leaks; also restructures error cleanup to maintain proper ordering (pm_put before buffer return) on all error paths.

candidates.rationale: When uvc_pm_get() fails, this return statement exits the function without calling uvc_queue_return_buffers(), violating the videobuf2 requirement to return all buffers on start_streaming failure.
This condition controls the early return that skips buffer cleanup; it enables the missing uvc_queue_return_buffers() call in the error path.
This statement is the source of the error that triggers the early return; while not directly omitting cleanup, its failure leads to the vulnerability.
